name: fingerly/fingerly-php
description: Server-side Fingerly SDK: event reads, webhook verification and a same-origin proxy for the browser SDK.

suggest.psr/http-client: To send API requests through your own PSR-18 client instead of ext-curl.
suggest.psr/http-factory: Required alongside psr/http-client when supplying your own client.
suggest.psr/http-server-middleware: To mount the same-origin proxy as PSR-15 middleware (Slim, Mezzio).
suggest.illuminate/http: To mount the same-origin proxy as Laravel middleware.
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: To mount the same-origin proxy as a Symfony kernel listener.
